items.note: What most visitors describe: an agent in production, personal data in reach, and nobody who has ever stopped it.

items.label: Exposed
items.note: Special-category data, an output that decides about a person, and no stop path at all.

items.label: Governed
items.note: Every good answer — and still a register, because the agent exists, it can be stopped only by interrupting a service, and the data in its reach is what it is.

RO-platform|RISK-1.because: Reviewed annually. The level is where the board wants it.

RO-board|RISK-1.because: We run an autonomous system on purpose. This is the entry that says so.
